posts.author: Jinx Adnix
posts.body:
So I have this tutorial in my game, where one character explains ability costs... But no matter what I do, SRD_BattleStatusCustomizer.js's HUD just refuses to show that the character has spent MP before showing the rest of the dialog.
I even went so far as to use events to manually update the MP value.

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
I don't have this plugin, however, this script call should refresh all of your windows on the scene no matter of it's an RPG Maker original game window or a custom one from a plugin:
JavaScript:
SceneManager._scene._windowLayer.children
    .filter(gameWindow => gameWindow.refresh)
    .forEach(gameWindow => gameWindow.refresh());
